decisions.reason: The organic poultry snack fits the announced organic expansion and still has its own page, but as a single niche item launched in 2023 it is among the more expendable products after the flagship platter was already withdrawn.
The premium sharing salami line sits squarely in the firm's core salami competence and has several variants, so the sunk investment in the line and its visible presence favour continuing it.

The organic Fleischwurst was publicly announced as a new member of the organic team only in 2024, so any weak early results can still be attributed to the start-up phase and dropping it would contradict the announced direction.

The recently launched organic chicken breast line with several flavours was announced as new and embodies the push into organic and new formats, so the commitment and justification pressures favour keeping it.
The organic herb-coated salami is a fresh 2024 launch close to the core business and fits the organic strategy, so it gets more time despite being a single item.
